name: Wishing Stardust
description: Obtained through Astral Imagea reclamation. Collect a certain amount to exchange for Trendible Vouchers at the Cosmetics Store.
story: The IPC's latest research findings, cleverly woven into the creation of collectible figures, mystery boxes, and other products, giving each toy a delightful personality of its own. The results speak for themselves as every new release flies off the shelves.
